ko.executive_summary: Samsung reportedly selected Snapdragon for Galaxy S27 Pro and Ultra models, signaling continued reliance on Qualcomm's flagship chip. Heterogeneous packaging and custom silicon architectures are emerging as key efficiency drivers for AI-capable mobile processors.

Heterogeneous packaging enables AI efficiency in XPU designs

Custom silicon and heterogeneous packaging become competitive differentiators for mobile AI performance

ko.executive_summary: Samsung and SK Haikiston are aggressively recruiting talent from Japan and expanding domestic hiring in March to capitalize on semiconductor boom and HPC/datacenter demand. Talent war intensifies as companies compete for skilled engineers amid rising Chinese competition for chip expertise.
key_facts: Samsung and SK Haikiston recruiting Japanese semiconductor talent at 18 million yen compensation
SK Haikiston hiring 19 youth ambassadors for talent pipeline development
March new hiring drive by Samsung and SK Haikiston
Chinese rivals competing for global semiconductor talent

implications.text: Korean chipmakers using premium compensation to poach skilled engineers from Japan and globally to support datacenter/HPC expansion
Rising Chinese chip talent competition and U.S. trade secret concerns intensify pressure on Korean firms to secure engineering resources
SK Haikiston's education/age-blind hiring model signals shift toward competency-driven talent acquisition over traditional credentials

ko.counterpoint: Aggressive overseas recruitment may face regulatory headwinds or visa restrictions in key markets like Japan and the U.S.

ko.executive_summary: Custom AI ASICs projected to reach USD 137.38 billion by 2035, driving a shift toward workload-specific silicon. MediaTek is building advanced packaging capabilities via Intel packaging veteran hires and dual CoWoS-EMIB strategy; Microsoft and Amazon are advancing EDA and inference capabilities on proprietary silicon.
key_facts: Custom AI ASIC market forecasted at USD 137.38 billion in 2035
MediaTek taps Intel packaging veteran, pursues dual CoWoS-EMIB strategy
Microsoft accelerates EDA workloads on Azure Cobalt 200
Amazon SageMaker Inference expands NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU support
Heterogeneous packaging and custom silicon drive AI efficiency

implications.text: Market shift toward workload-specific ASICs suggests hyperscalers and fabless firms prioritize differentiated AI architectures over general-purpose GPUs
MediaTek's recruitment of Intel veterans and CoWoS-EMIB investment indicate advanced packaging as critical competitive lever for custom SoC design
Microsoft and Amazon investments in proprietary silicon and inference optimization accelerate vertical integration of AI infrastructure

ko.counterpoint: USD 137.38 billion ASIC forecast is speculative; actual market adoption depends on standardization, yield maturity, and cost competitiveness versus GPU alternatives.

ko.executive_summary: Market turmoil triggered by U.S. midterm election fallout and geopolitical concerns over NVIDIA's China exposure caused sharp stock declines in Samsung and SK Haikiston. Micron's Taiwan fab construction halt creates supply shortage opportunities for Korean competitors; NVIDIA introduces RTX Spark for on-device AI, while Intel Nova Lake-H leaks show six-tile TSMC N2P and Intel 18A-P designs.
key_facts: NVIDIA CEO Jenson Huang summoned by U.S. Congress over alleged Chinese spy connection
Samsung stock dropped sharply; executives purchased shares at 210,000 KRW
Micron halts Taiwan Fab 11E construction; scheduled 2028 completion postponed
NVIDIA RTX Spark combines GPU and CPU in single chip for local AI PC market
Intel Nova Lake-H uses TSMC N2P and Intel 18A-P tiles in six-tile design
Korean stock market (KOSPI) fell below 5000 amid semiconductor and AI stock selloff

implications.text: U.S. Congressional scrutiny of NVIDIA and China trade secret concerns elevate regulatory uncertainty for semiconductor supply chains
Micron's Taiwan fab halt creates temporary memory supply shortage, benefiting Samsung and SK Haikiston in AI-driven datacenter demand
NVIDIA RTX Spark and Intel tile strategies indicate foundries facing demand for heterogeneous, compute-optimized designs beyond traditional monolithic dies
Sharp equity declines in Korean chipmakers reflect broader AI sector consolidation and geopolitical uncertainty affecting investor sentiment

ko.counterpoint: Congressional summons is political theater without confirmed trade violations; stock selloff may be overdone if AI and memory demand fundamentals remain intact.
